title: Senior Data Scientist
must_have: 6+ years of experience in data science
text:
Senior Data Scientist
Deccan Insights | Full-time | Hybrid, India

ABOUT THE ROLE
We are hiring a senior data scientist to join our data science team. You will work with cross-functional partners and own outcomes end to end.

MUST-HAVE REQUIREMENTS:
- A/B Testing
- Scikit-learn
- SQL
- Machine Learning
- Feature Engineering
- 6+ years of experience in data science

NICE-TO-HAVE:
- Data Visualization
- PyTorch
- Statistics
- MLflow

WHAT YOU WILL DO
- Drive customer segmentation refresh with measurable outcomes.
- Drive demand planning revamp with measurable outcomes.
- Drive pricing experiment framework with measurable outcomes.
